name: Taking Care Of Parents
overview: Scripture clearly commands honoring and respecting parents as a vital expression of obedience to God, promising blessings and longevity in the land given by the LORD (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). This includes reverence for their authority and care for them in old age, as seen in instructions to fear and honor both father and mother, and to rise before the elderly (Leviticus 19:3, 19:32). Proverbs further warns against neglecting or mistreating parents, portraying such behavior as shameful and reproachful (Proverbs 19:26, 23:22). Thus, taking care of parents is a God-ordained duty reflecting both respect for family and reverence for God Himself.
